name: POS Manager Validation
description: POS Manager Validation enhances security in Point of Sale by enforcing manager authentication before allowing sensitive POS operations. The module helps prevent unauthorized actions by cashiers and ensures stronger financial control by requiring approved managers to validate critical activities such as price changes, discounts, refunds, cash in/out, and order deletion. It supports both PIN-based and password-based validation
summary: POS Manager Validation is a powerful security enhancement for Point of Sale that gives businesses full control over sensitive POS operations. In high-volume retail and restaurant environments, unauthorized actions such as price changes, excessive discounts, refunds, cash movements, or order deletions can result in financial loss and operational inconsistencies. This module addresses these risks by enforcing mandatory manager approval before critical POS actions are performed. Administrators can configure which POS operations require authorization and assign specific users as managers. When a cashier attempts a restricted action, a secure validation popup appears directly within the POS interface, prompting the manager to authenticate using a PIN or password. Only after successful validation is the action allowed, ensuring accountability, preventing misuse, and maintaining strict operational control. The module supports a wide range of configurable validations, including cash in/out, discounts, price changes, order and order-line deletion, payments, refunds, invoicing, and payment method changes. It also includes an optional virtual keyboard for secure touchscreen input and works seamlessly in offline POS mode, ensuring uninterrupted operation. name: POS Product by Lot / Serial Barcode
description: POS Product by Lot / Serial Number Barcode enables Odoo Point of Sale users to sell lot- or serial-tracked products by scanning the lot or serial number barcode directly in the POS screen. When a lot/serial number is scanned, the system automatically identifies the linked product, validates available stock for that specific lot, assigns the lot to the POS order line, and adds the product to the order without any manual selection.
summary: The POS Product by Lot / Serial Number Barcode module enhances Odoo Point of Sale by enabling accurate lot and serial number–based selling directly from the POS interface. Products configured with lot or serial tracking are strictly validated at the lot level, ensuring that only lots with available on-hand quantity can be sold. The module keeps POS and Inventory fully synchronized, allowing real-time stock verification whenever a lot or serial number is scanned. This ensures precise inventory control and prevents errors that may occur when relying only on total product stock instead of individual lot availability. When a POS user scans a lot or serial number barcode, the system automatically identifies the linked product and verifies the available quantity for that specific lot. If the scanned lot has no stock, the POS instantly displays a clear Out of Stock alert and blocks the sale, preventing negative inventory and incorrect product allocation. This functionality allows the POS user to add products simply by scanning their Lot/Serial Number, supporting workflows such as Lot Number Scan, Serial Number Scan, POS Lot Scan, and Add Lot Item Scan. name: Stop Showing Popup Window Chat
description: Stop Showing Popup Window Chat is a lightweight Odoo module designed to enhance user experience by disabling the default popup chat window.   By default, Odoo displays a popup chat window whenever a new message arrives. If multiple messages are received, Odoo opens multiple popup windows, which can quickly become distracting and cluttered. This behaviour is not only inconvenient but can also compromise the privacy of chat content by showing sensitive information in unexpected popups.  Stop Showing Popup Window Chat solves this problem by disabling the automatic popup chat windows. Messages remain accessible through the standard chat panel, ensuring a cleaner interface, better focus, and improved privacy for all users.

name: POS Smart Return & Refund
description: POS Smart Return & Refund allows POS users to easily process full or partial returns directly from the Odoo Point of Sale interface by enabling them to fetch previous POS orders for all customers or a specific customer, select returnable products, define return quantities, and automatically generate refund orders with complete traceability between the original sale and the return transaction.
summary: POS Smart Return & Refund is a powerful Odoo POS extension designed to return orders in a running Point of Sale session, supporting Return Order | Order Return | Return | Custom Order Return workflows. It allows POS users to fetch previous orders for all customers or a specific customer, select eligible products, define return quantities with proper validation, and create refund orders directly from the POS interface without interrupting the sales flow. Each return generates a dedicated refund POS order that is automatically linked to the original order, ensuring complete traceability across POS, inventory, and accounting. Product-level return restrictions help enforce business policies by preventing refunds on non-returnable items, while the smooth and intuitive workflow maintains accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency.
